messages:
ashley: starting the monthly least-privilege sweep for May. primary goals: 1) validate owners for all admin-level KMS grants, 2) detect key-policy drift, 3) investigate anomalous decrypt spikes seen last week. please chime in with owners or mark "no longer required" with a short justification. deadline: 2024-05-10 EOD.

devops: scope? include cross-account grants and old debugging elevations?

ashley: yes to both. cross-account grants count if they permit Decrypt/Sign/Admin. debugging elevations older than 60 days should be flagged for revoke.

samir: saw a decrypt spike on 2024-04-22 for key key-prod-payments-01. spike correlated with a deploy but some requests came from an unexpected principal. raised SEC-4002.

marta: can you paste a sanitized log snippet? we need to see principal and IP ranges.

samir: snippet below (sanitized):
```log
2024-04-22T11:03:12Z principal=svc-orderproc-prod action=Decrypt key=key-prod-payments-01 src_ip=10.24.18.99 result=Success
2024-04-22T11:03:13Z principal=svc-orderproc-prod action=Decrypt key=key-prod-payments-01 src_ip=54.210.13.7 result=Success
2024-04-22T11:03:14Z principal=unknown-bot action=Decrypt key=key-prod-payments-01 src_ip=203.0.113.45 result=Denied
```

samir: unknown-bot was denied but it's worth tracing.

jordan: payments infra confirms svc-orderproc-prod did a large batch job that day. i'll correlate with deploy timeline.

luis: adding to that, earlier this month vuln scanner flagged hsm-agent 2.0.1 which has CVE-2024-3130 (info leak). vulnbot also sent alerts. could be unrelated but we should patch and rotate affected keys if HSM host was using them.

vulnbot: detected: hsm-agent v2.0.1 on hosts [hsm-03,hsm-04]. recommended: upgrade to v2.1.0, rotate keys used by those hosts. ticket created: SEC-4003.

ashley: action items so far: (A) samir to trace decrypt spike + update SEC-4002; (B) devops to schedule hsm-agent upgrades & key rotation plan (SEC-4003); (C) everybody assigned owner verification for grants they know.

devops: creating a policy-drift detector rule. initial query (elastic-style):
```json
{
  "query": {
    "bool": {
      "must": [
        {"term": {"event": "kms.PolicyChange"}},
        {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "now-30d"}}}
      ]
    }
  },
  "aggs": {"by_key": {"terms": {"field": "key_id"}}}
}
```

devops: rule will create alerts when policy changes occur outside of the approved change window and will attach the diff. initial mode: alert-only for 14 days.

marta: +1 on alert-only. also propose adding an entitlement-linter hook to require an owner on grants that grant Decrypt/Sign/Admin. linter should create a temporary auto-expire grant if owner is missing (30d TTL) and send a batch notice.

ashley: that helps with stale grants. example linter rule: 
```yaml
name: require-owner-for-admin-grants
conditions:
  - grant.privileges intersects [Decrypt,Sign,Admin]
  - grant.owner == null
actions:
  - create: auto_expiring_grant(ttl=30d)
  - notify: #eng-security, #owners
  - file_ticket: SEC-AUTO-OWNER-ASSIGN
```

luis: question: do we snapshot audit logs retention for the sweep? we'd like 365 days for correlation with older tickets.

devops: we can snapshot to cold storage for up to 1 year with negligible cost bump if compressed. will post link when done.

auditbot: automated scan: 7 admin-level grants without owners detected across prod+payment-staging. uploaded CSV: https://redwood.internal/snapshots/may-2024-ownerless.csv ticket: SEC-4004.

samir: i'm taking ownership of tracing key-prod-payments-01 decrypts (SEC-4002). will provide timeline and PR for any needed revokes.

jordan: payments staging owners: added owner map in the shared sheet and noted two debug grants that can be removed.

marta: good. timeline: owners update sheet by 2024-05-10 EOD. devops to enable alert-only detector today; escalate to enforcement after review on 2024-05-24. security will run post-mortem if any unexplained denies/accepts remain.

ashley: also adding an incident-runbook snippet for emergency key revoke to the playbooks repo. quick steps: 1) create revoke job in infra-cmd, 2) notify affected services via console, 3) rotate backups. will share link.

devops: created runbook stub: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/kms-emergency-revoke.md
auditbot: SEC-4004 updated: owners_needed = 7, assigned = [jordan, luis, marta], due = 2024-05-10.

marta: thanks all. final ask: when you mark "no longer required" include the re-request owner and the expected re-provision path so we can automate recovery if necessary.

ashley: acknowledged. i'll follow up with a short retro after the sweep closes.

vulnbot: reminder: CVE-2024-3130 patch window = 7 days. hosts listed in SEC-4003 must be remediated or mitigated by 2024-05-02.

samir: will update SEC-4002 and SEC-4004 as I progress. ping me for logs access.

marta: closing thread for coordination. ping here if you hit blockers. :white_check_mark:
